title_ar: ألعاب إبداعية عبر الشاشة — أو بدون الشاشة
practice_model_ar: اختر لعبة جاهزة أو أنشئ لعبتك، ثم نفذها على الشاشة أو حوّلها إلى ورقة أو نشاط واقعي. معاينة اللعبة المصممة تعمل كجولة لعب فعلية منفصلة عن لوحة التصميم: العناصر تُخلط، الإجابات لا تُكشف، الصوت والتغذية الراجعة يعملان، وبعد الإكمال يمكن إعادة الجولة دون تغيير التصميم الأصلي.

features: 170 progressive ready games across four readiness levels
screen paper and off-screen practice paths
A4 worksheet designer and electronic game designer
shared drawing board and recorded-name audio assets
local save load drafts JSON export import and offline PWA shell
legacy Android touch bridge plus modern mobile multi-selection controls
electronic game designer supports choice multi-mark matching two-group sorting and ordered-sequence games
geometric shape library including circle square rectangle triangle star heart arrow hexagon diamond and line
type-aware automatic editor layout remains enabled by default
v18 preview never rewrites the editor layout; the saved design remains intact before during and after play testing
v18 creates a fresh shuffled non-overlapping play layout for every test/replay so matching and ordering are real challenges rather than answer-revealing editor arrangements

v18 validates every game type before play: choice requires a correct answer, multi-mark requires targets, matching requires every item to belong to a pair used exactly twice, sorting requires both groups, and ordering requires a complete unique 1..N sequence
v18 choice mode gives immediate correct/wrong feedback and completion state
v18 multi-mark mode supports free selection then explicit verification
v18 matching mode uses two-step pair selection with matched pairs locked only after a correct match
v18 sorting mode uses neutral shuffled items and explicit destination group buttons
v18 ordering mode requires the hidden logical sequence while visual item positions are shuffled
v18 play testing includes sound effects, Arabic spoken feedback when available, sound toggle, progress, close, replay and completion actions
v18 replay reshuffles a fresh round without mutating the underlying designed game
v18 print uses the designed layout synchronously and never exposes correct answers or pair numbers
v18 mobile quick selection bar is hidden whenever the game settings drawer is open and returns after settings close, preventing the bar from covering the last settings controls
implementation.result_boundary_ar: النتيجة تصف الجولة داخل الشاشة فقط؛ ليست قياس ذكاء أو نمو ولا دليلًا على الأداء خارج الشاشة.

audience_note_ar: المدرب يصمم أو يكيّف اللعبة، والطفل ينفذها على الشاشة أو في الواقع.
